t: The wording avoids the act itself
a: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَـٰحِشَةً وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًا
p: Wa lā taqrabu-z-zinā, innahu kāna fāḥishatan wa sā'a sabīlā.
m: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
